joined_facts: Factory 0x140432790 case 0x143 installs CControlObjectState and constructs CStateTexts at object +0xde8.
Intentional edit caller 0x14019de60 tests control type 0x143, dynamically casts to CControlObjectState, constructs CStateTextDlg via 0x14093f320, and passes owner +0xde8 to 0x140942bc0.

Dialog constructor 0x14093f320 constructs its own CStateTexts at dialog +0x90. Initialization 0x140942bc0 invokes that local list's virtual +8 and builds row providers; this does not identify the virtual target.

Row-provider construction 0x140942880 stores each native row pointer at complete-provider +0x30 and exposes provider +0x10 to the model. Candidate accessor bodies use adjusted-provider +0x20, consistent with that row pointer, but actual virtual bindings are still required.

Candidate setter 0x140942bf0 column 14 converts QVariant to QString, calls 0x14041db10 into row +0x158, then unconditionally invokes 0x1407149c0 and 0x140714c80. Candidate getter 0x140940300 returns the same member for column 14.

Existing conversion helper 0x14041db10 uses QString::toUtf8 followed by strlen and byte copying. Embedded NUL is not a byte-preserving input. There is no trimming or explicit text-length limit in this helper, but this alone does not prove editor limits.
Validator 0x1407149c0 writes row +8; validator 0x140714c80 writes row +0xc. Therefore even a label edit can affect validity for both label and value/template; preserving all flags cannot be assumed.
On accepted dialog result 1, 0x14019de60 invokes virtual +8 on owner +0xde8 with the local dialog list, then performs document-change notifications. The accepted-copy target remains unresolved.

Candidate container copy 0x140715100 recreates the destination list and invokes row virtual +8. Candidate record copy 0x140714f40 copies text, value/template, flags, conditions and icon fields. Neither body's relevant table binding is established.

Container serializer 0x140717510 opens StateTexts, serializes a count at +8, and visits rows in stored order via row virtual +0x10. Candidate row serializer 0x140717170 opens StateText and serializes validity, strings, icon and conditions. Their ownership and virtual joins are still required.

Candidate dialog cleanup 0x140941a60 collapses trailing unconditional rows and updates the list count. Its acceptance callback binding is unresolved, so this is a preservation hazard, not established edit behavior.
